status_legend.PROVEN_REAL: The named external binary executed against a synthetic local target during this evaluation.

status_legend.UNAVAILABLE: No acceptable off-repository binary was found.
status_legend.SKIPPED: The engine was disabled or no applicable executable property was available.
status_legend.INCONCLUSIVE: Execution prerequisites were absent or the resulting evidence could not establish a proof or counterexample.
status_legend.MIXED: Real execution exists for a bounded subpath, but the production maximum-assurance integration remains unproven.

assurance_contract_assay.method: Pure deterministic mutation assay over the real MaximumAssuranceContract using the synthetic complete runtime helper. No target or external binary was executed.

defects_and_gaps.observation: The compilation requirement passes when compilation was attempted, even when every compilation result is FAILED.
defects_and_gaps.mitigation_elsewhere: Pipeline quality gates separately require CompilationStatus.SUCCESS.

defects_and_gaps.observation: Any non-empty formal run inventory satisfies the required inventory clause. Successful formal or symbolic execution is optional unless the operator explicitly populates formal.required_tools.
A high/critical candidate with attempts greater than zero satisfies the reproduction clause even when state is NOT_REPRODUCED and successful_attempts is zero.
defects_and_gaps.mitigation_elsewhere: Pipeline quality gates separately require verified reproduction integrity for eligible candidates.

defects_and_gaps.observation: A current benchmark certificate is not required by the default maximum-assurance configuration. It fails closed only when benchmark_gate or CI mode is explicitly enabled.

Echidna, Medusa, Halmos, Kontrol, Certora, Mythril, solc-SMTChecker, and foundry-invariant are not individually mandatory because required_tools is empty. The assay reached COMPLETE with only a synthetic solc-SMTChecker success record.
Reproduction and scanner runners share the configured isolation backend, while FormalRunner independently auto-selects a backend and does not receive the configured rootless image.
defects_and_gaps.effect: An operator-supplied pinned rootless image does not establish formal execution through the default pipeline construction.

defects_and_gaps.observation: Certora requires a remote service, but the evaluated FormalRunner path uses the normal network-denying isolation wrapper. No real network-enabled isolated Certora execution was demonstrated.
Invariant and reproduction artifacts do not record and manifest-bind the actual Forge executable path, version, and checksum.

defects_and_gaps.source: public CLI maximum-assurance run followed immediately by verify-run
defects_and_gaps.observation: verify-run returned STALE with compiler, full configuration, model configuration, and scanner configuration mismatches because the run used a CLI profile override that verify-run cannot accept.
